description: Required fields for Newport terrain and prop assets. Assets with placeholder=false and review_eligible=true must pass both Newport Visual Cohesion and Asset Provenance gates.
permanent_gate: No asset enters the player-facing review build unless it passes both Newport Visual Cohesion and Asset Provenance gates.

review_source_policy.project_owned_newport_crops: allowed only when exact source path, crop rectangle, and ownership are documented
review_source_policy.deterministic_generated_assets: allowed when creation script and generated piece path are documented

hard_rule: If placeholder is false and review_eligible is true, the asset must satisfy the Newport Visual Cohesion Rules and Asset Provenance gate: muted palette, dark outline or dark-side shading, internal material detail, contact shadow where seated, scale compatibility with building doors/windows/player, exact source documentation, and no unsafe third-party or mystery pixels.
